objective: Audit same-bound replacement of global average degree by maximum average degree or degree-two deletion, using an explicit conditional high-girth core-preserving transformation.

atomic_claims.text: An unchanged graph without a matching cut remains without one after adding an edgeless set of vertices each joined to two distinct old vertices.
A finite maximal set of legal same-part edges with bounded added degree supplies more than kn/4 edges when the initial order exceeds four radius-(g-2) ball bounds.
Subdividing only the artificial edges gives a simple 2-connected bipartite graph of the required girth, with degree-two vertices forming an edgeless set and no matching cut.
Conditional on T14, every d>4 and g>=3 admit a graph of global average degree <d and bounded maximum degree containing an induced 14-regular core; the construction makes no endpoint claim at d=4.

assumptions: The unchanged contract requires finite simple graphs and nonempty shores; empty crossing matchings are allowed.
T14 is the explicitly attributed pending literature dependency in C03, not an additional allowed axiom.
All old core edges remain, new vertices have two distinct old neighbours, and distances are taken in the current augmented graph.
Only finite maximality, elementary graph counting and real arithmetic supplement the external seed dependency.
risks: Nonterminal ambiguous_problem_contract remains; neither admitted obligation is closed.
The T14 dependency and the transformation still require trusted semantic and mathematical review.
Global average degree, maximum average degree and degeneracy are different parameters; the construction cannot be used with d<=4.
No graph generator, solver, proof assistant or repository command was run; no novelty or optimal-threshold claim is made.
